'''Kossimus''' is a male researcher found at the '''Research Institute''' above Starward Riseway.

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Kossimus:'''  Whenever my mind hits a wall, I come stand here for a while.

:'''Kossimus:'''  I once read that humans look up at the stars to contemplate our place in the vast cosmos.

:{{DIcon}} Our place in the vast cosmos?

:'''Kossimus:'''  Yes, our place. Like instinctively pulling up a map on your Terminal. Consciousness is always asking three big questions: Where did we start? Where are we now? And... just how far can we go?

:'''Kossimus:''' That's where all science begins.

:'''Kossimus:''' Hah.. But now that humanity's right to explore outer space has been taken from us, all we can do is literally "dig deeper."

:{{DIcon}} What is your research about?

:'''Kossimus:'''  My study focuses on the domain construction mechanisms of the [[Etheric Sea]] and its blockade effect on near-ground space flight.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds interesting.
::'''Kossimus:''' Haha, you think? Are you... a student from Rabelle College? I'm counting on your generation to finally reach outer space. I'd love to be around to see it.
:{{DIcon}} Sounds really complicated...
::'''Kossimus:''' Hehe. It's like trying to negotiate with an ocean that makes all the rules but follows none. Still, someone has to learn how to talk to it.

:'''Kossimus:'''  Thank you for the conversation. Talking with the young always shakes the dust off my thoughts.
{{Dialogue End}}
